_signals: Conventional Commits detected in git history
Branch naming enforced by push.yml CI
AES-256 encryption key in single-file CLI

hooks.command:
bash -c '
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

# Only validate when git commit is in the command
if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git commit"; then
  exit 0
fi

# Extract the commit message from -m flag
msg=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oP "(?<=-m )[\x27\"][^\x27\"]*[\x27\"]" | head -1 | sed "s/^[\x27\"]//;s/[\x27\"]$//")

# Also handle heredoc-style (cat <<EOF piped to git commit)
if [ -z "$msg" ]; then
  msg=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oP "(?<=-m )\$\(cat <<.*?EOF.*?EOF\)" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
fi

# If no -m flag found, allow (interactive commit or --amend without message)
if [ -z "$msg" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Validate Conventional Commits format
valid_types="feat|fix|chore|docs|test|refactor|perf|ci|build|style"
subject=$(echo "$msg" | head -1)

if ! echo "$subject" | grep -qP "^($valid_types)(\\([^)]+\\))?!?: .{1,72}$"; then
  echo "ERROR: Commit message does not follow Conventional Commits format."
  echo ""
  echo "  Expected format:  <type>(<scope>): <description>"
  echo "  Valid types:      feat, fix, chore, docs, test, refactor, perf, ci, build, style"
  echo "  Subject line max: 72 characters"
  echo ""
  echo "  Examples:"
  echo "    feat(plugins): add branch naming guard"
  echo "    fix(cli): correct argument parsing in cmd_feedback"
  echo "    chore: release v0.9.3"
  echo ""
  echo "  Your message: $subject"
  len=$(echo -n "$subject" | wc -c)
  if [ "$len" -gt 72 ]; then
    echo "  Issue: subject line is $len characters (max 72)"
  fi
  exit 1
fi
exit 0
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\") or d.get(\"path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [ -z "$file_path" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

basename=$(basename "$file_path")

# Check sensitive file patterns
if echo "$basename" | grep -qiE "^\.(env)(\..+)?$|^credentials|secret|^\.secret"; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Attempt to write to a sensitive file."
  echo ""
  echo "  File: $file_path"
  echo ""
  echo "  Sensitive file patterns that are protected:"
  echo "    .env, .env.*, *credentials*, *secret*"
  echo ""
  echo "  If this is intentional, perform the edit manually outside Claude Code."
  exit 1
fi

# Check for encryption key file or patterns containing _get_key
if echo "$basename" | grep -qiE "\.key$|\.pem$|\.p12$|\.pfx$"; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Attempt to write to a key or certificate file."
  echo ""
  echo "  File: $file_path"
  echo ""
  echo "  Key/cert file extensions that are protected: .key, .pem, .p12, .pfx"
  echo "  If this is intentional, perform the edit manually outside Claude Code."
  exit 1
fi

exit 0
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

# Only check when git checkout -b or git branch (new branch creation) is in the command
if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git (checkout -b|branch [^-])"; then
  exit 0
fi

# Extract the branch name
# Handle: git checkout -b feat/my-branch or git branch feat/my-branch [base]
branch=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oP "(?<=git checkout -b )\S+" | head -1)
if [ -z "$branch" ]; then
  branch=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oP "(?<=git branch )(?!-)[\S]+" | head -1)
fi

if [ -z "$branch" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

valid_pattern="^(feat|fix|chore|docs|test|refactor|perf|ci|build|style|release|hotfix)/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$"

if ! echo "$branch" | grep -qP "$valid_pattern"; then
  echo "WARNING: Branch name does not follow the required convention."
  echo ""
  echo "  Branch created: $branch"
  echo ""
  echo "  Required format:  <type>/<short-description>"
  echo "  Valid types:      feat, fix, chore, docs, test, refactor, perf, ci, build, style, release, hotfix"
  echo "  Description:      lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only, must start with a letter or digit"
  echo ""
  echo "  Examples:"
  echo "    feat/new-plugin-xyz"
  echo "    fix/install-claude-guard"
  echo "    docs/update-readme"
  echo ""
  echo "  This branch WILL be rejected by CI (push.yml enforces naming)."
  echo "  Rename it now with:"
  echo "    git branch -m $branch <type>/<description>"
fi

exit 0
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\") or d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [ -z "$file_path" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Only remind for files under the plugins/ directory
if ! echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/plugins/"; then
  exit 0
fi

echo "REMINDER: You modified a file under plugins/."
echo ""
echo "  File: $file_path"
echo ""
echo "  Run validation before committing:"
echo "    claude-kit validate --changed"
echo ""
echo "  Also verify version + README badge consistency for any plugin you touched:"
echo "    jq -r .version plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json"
echo "    grep \"Version:\" plugins/<name>/README.md"

exit 0
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\") or d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [ -z "$file_path" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Only trigger for files under docs/
if ! echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/"; then
  exit 0
fi

# Identify which layer was modified
layer=""
if echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/requirements/"; then
  layer="requirements"
  echo "REMINDER: You modified a requirements document."
  echo ""
  echo "  Upstream check: Does this trace to a research paper or stakeholder need?"
  echo "  Downstream check: Do any ADRs or SPECs reference this REQ and need updating?"
elif echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/architecture/"; then
  layer="architecture"
  echo "REMINDER: You modified an architecture document."
  echo ""
  echo "  If this is an accepted ADR: do NOT edit it — create a new ADR and supersede."
  echo "  Upstream check: Does this trace to a REQ?"
  echo "  Downstream check: Do any SPECs reference this ADR?"
elif echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/specs/"; then
  layer="specs"
  echo "REMINDER: You modified a spec document."
  echo ""
  echo "  Upstream check: Does this trace to REQs and ADRs?"
  echo "  Downstream check: Is there TEST evidence for this spec?"
elif echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/testing/"; then
  layer="testing"
  echo "REMINDER: You modified a testing document."
  echo ""
  echo "  Upstream check: Does this trace to a SPEC?"
  echo "  Downstream check: Were any REG regressions discovered?"
elif echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/benchmarks/"; then
  layer="benchmarks"
  echo "REMINDER: You modified a benchmark document."
  echo ""
  echo "  Upstream check: Does this trace to a REQ or SPEC?"
  echo "  Downstream check: Do benchmark results inform any ADRs?"
elif echo "$file_path" | grep -q "/docs/operations/"; then
  layer="operations"
  echo "REMINDER: You modified an operations document."
  echo ""
  echo "  Cross-check: Are related REGs, RBs, or MIGs up to date?"
fi

if [ -n "$layer" ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "  Run docs validation before committing:"
  echo "    bash scripts/validate-docs.sh"
fi

exit 0
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\") or d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [ -z "$file_path" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Skip docs/ and plugins/ paths — they have their own hooks
if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE "/docs/|/plugins/"; then
  exit 0
fi

# Only trigger for core code paths
if ! echo "$file_path" | grep -qE "/claude-kit$|/scripts/|/\.github/workflows/|/templates/"; then
  exit 0
fi

echo "REMINDER: You modified a core code file."
echo ""
echo "  File: $file_path"
echo ""
echo "  Check if docs/ needs updating:"
echo "    - Component docs: docs/architecture/components/"
echo "    - Active specs: docs/specs/ (update status if completing a spec step)"
echo "    - Migration guides: docs/operations/migration/ (if this is a breaking change)"

exit 0
'
